title: Mark Your Calendars: Jupyter Day 2026 is Coming to San Jose!
content_html:
Join us on October 19 for a full day of talks, posters, and community discussion on the future of interactive computing. Submit a talk by September 13 or sponsor the event!

Project Jupyter has always grown around its community. From early notebook hacks to large-scale deployments across research labs and universities, what makes this ecosystem work is the people building tools, running infrastructure, and sharing workflows.

That is why we are excited to announce Jupyter Day 2026, happening on Monday, October 19, 2026, at the San Jose Convention Center in California!

This year, we are co-locating with PyTorch Conference North America. If you are already planning to be in town for PyTorch, you can easily add Jupyter Day to your week — or you can simply register to attend Jupyter Day on its own!

What We Are Covering

Jupyter Day is a focused event for developers, maintainers, data scientists, educators, and system admins to talk about real-world setups and future project architecture.

Here are the main tracks and suggested topics for the event:

  • Data Science: How Jupyter is used by data science practitioners across industry, government, research, and beyond.
  • Community & Ecosystem: Insights into the Jupyter community, frontends, kernels, custom extensions, and essential ecosystem tools.
  • Research and Scientific Discovery: Practical applications in specific scientific fields, including medical research, astronomy, physics, climate science, meteorology, social sciences, and the humanities.
  • Education: Practical methods and strategies for teaching and learning with Jupyter across diverse educational settings.
  • Jupyter Infrastructure: Deploying Jupyter and JupyterHub at scale across high-performance computing, cloud environments, enterprise, and academia — covering DevOps, scaling, security, and compliance.
  • AI & Machine Learning: Leveraging AI and machine learning inside Jupyter and using Jupyter environments to drive ML development.

Whether you want to showcase a JupyterLab extension you built, explain a tricky deployment setup, or discuss new open standards, we want to hear from you.

Call for Proposals is Open!

The Call for Proposals (CFP) is live right now. We are looking for technical talks, panel ideas, and poster presentations from every part of the community.

  • CFP Deadline: Sunday, September 13, 2026 at 11:59 PM PDT
  • Submit your proposal: Jupyter Day CFP Portal

Sponsor Jupyter Day 2026

Put your organization front and center at Jupyter Day 2026! Sponsoring this event connects your brand directly with core developers, researchers, and AI leaders building the future of open-source interactive computing.

  • View opportunities: Download the Jupyter Day 2026 Sponsorship Prospectus.
  • Get in touch: Reach out to jupyterevents@linuxfoundation.org to reserve your sponsorship or ask questions.

You can find full event details, hotel info, and registration links directly on the Linux Foundation event page.

We hope to see you in San Jose this October!

Mark Your Calendars: Jupyter Day 2026 is Coming to San Jose! was originally published in Jupyter Blog on Medium, where people are continuing the conversation by highlighting and responding to this story.
